review_notes.status: Private native-source review complete. All 35 printed boxes, 98 terminals, external continuations, wire routes, connector table, and footer were checked against the RX091 TIFF; independent acceptance is pending.

review_notes.evidence: The full-resolution RX091 bank strips show six 0512 R TO boxes and 5G 8002AD that are not listed among the 28 A1 card portions. All seven source boxes are retained.
The native ink reads J102+J103&E05. The ALD text alphabet omits ampersand, so the 245-column text renders the conjunction as +; the original glyph is recorded here verbatim.

Native crop RX091 3K B12 lower all rails.png shows the B12 riser crossing the upper BJ4 continuation and local 4N return, then bending right into the lower RX291 equals-one rail. The short vertical gaps repeat at the native dashed-line cadence and are not open ends.

Native RX091 2G upper 3E third 8x.png and RX091 2G upper destination x4035.png show the 2G unlabelled upper output rising on x≈3915, bending east at y≈2500, and following the dashed x≈4035 riser to 3E third. It crosses the fourth and fifth input horizontals without diamonds.

Native RX091 2G B10 bottom x4670 8x.png shows 2G.B10 folding down at x≈3995, east at y≈4790, then south at x≈4670 through the printed dashed-line cadence. True diamonds join the separate KK4 equals-one and AK4 page-exception rails. 6G.B12 and 1K.B02 are additional outputs printed on this common physical net; BJ4 remains separate.

2C.D13 bends up at native x≈3715 to the 3A top input; the lower 2M.D12 x≈3710 riser is separated by a large blank span. Separately, 1G.D11 descends at native x≈3792 and turns into 3N.D07 at y≈5680; 2K.D12 common is the adjacent x≈3830 gate riser.
